name: dt-sec-contextualization
description: Resolve security signals, IoC matches, or Smartscape nodes to runtime entities, connect findings across entity levels, verify external findings against RVA on the same entity, and measure scan coverage against a Smartscape denominator. Covers identity mapping, RVA id resolution, K8s pod vs. node CVE topology, AI-service vulnerabilities, coverage counts. Trigger: "map these findings to workloads/hosts", "which workload does this image run as", "is this scanner finding also detected by RVA on a running workload", "which AI services have vulnerabilities", "enrich this IoC match", "which report mentions this IoC", "hosts not covered by scanning". Queries security.events only for THREAT_REPORT IoC enrichment, coverage numerators, joining supplied findings, RVA verification, and AI-service findings. Do NOT use for broad posture, rankings, or an entity's vulnerabilities (dt-sec-insights), general DQL (dt-dql-essentials), IoC hunting in logs/spans (dt-sec-ioc-hunting), K8s observability (dt-obs-kubernetes).
